WITH LatestSilver AS
(
    SELECT
        batch_id,
        object_id,
        run_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY batch_id, object_id
            ORDER BY attempt_number DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM metadata.table_run_log
    WHERE batch_id = CAST('@{pipeline().parameters.p_batch_id}' AS BIGINT)
      AND layer_name = 'SILVER'
),
LatestGold AS
(
    SELECT
        batch_id,
        object_id,
        run_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY batch_id, object_id
            ORDER BY attempt_number DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM metadata.table_run_log
    WHERE batch_id = CAST('@{pipeline().parameters.p_batch_id}' AS BIGINT)
      AND layer_name = 'GOLD'
)
SELECT
    oc.object_id,
    oc.source_schema,
    oc.source_table,
    oc.target_table,
    oc.execution_order
FROM metadata.object_config oc
INNER JOIN LatestSilver s
    ON oc.object_id = s.object_id
   AND s.rn = 1
   AND s.run_status = 'SUCCESS'
LEFT JOIN LatestGold g
    ON oc.object_id = g.object_id
   AND g.rn = 1
WHERE oc.is_active = 1
  AND oc.gold_enabled = 1
  AND g.object_id IS NULL
ORDER BY oc.execution_order;

UPDATE metadata.table_run_log
SET
    run_status = 'SUCCESS',
    end_time = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    modified_date = SYSUTCDATETIME()
WHERE batch_id = CAST('@{variables('v_batch_id')}' AS BIGINT)
  AND layer_name = 'GOLD'
  AND run_status = 'RUNNING';

UPDATE metadata.table_run_log
SET
    run_status = 'FAILED',
    end_time = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    error_message = 'Gold notebook execution failed',
    modified_date = SYSUTCDATETIME()
WHERE batch_id = CAST('@{variables('v_batch_id')}' AS BIGINT)
  AND layer_name = 'GOLD'
  AND run_status = 'RUNNING';
